# Wiki Log

Append-only chronological record of `init`, `ingest`, `query`, and `lint` operations on this wiki.

**Rules:** Append new entries at the end of this file. Do not edit or delete prior entries.

Log heading format (required — see `SCHEMA.md` in this directory):

```text
## [YYYY-MM-DD] {operation} | {title}
```

Where `{operation}` is one of: `init`, `ingest`, `query`, `lint` (lowercase).
